description: Fontaines d'ornement à Issy-les-Moulineaux is a dataset listed in Issy-les-moulineaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Localisation et description des fontaines et bassins d'ornement présents sur le Territoire Retrouvez le jeu de données des bornes-fontaines ici. Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal files it under Culture, Patrimoine. Its keywords are Fontaines d'ornement, îlots de fraîcheur, Ville durable. The portal shows 20 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-07-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-issy-com-portal.
